contract.hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, SM120a
contract.fft: 4096-point FP32 cuFFT with linear complex interpolation to 1024 uniform-angle beams
contract.consumer: direct power accumulation and deterministic top-1; no interpolated complex output
contract.timing: CUDA events, 20 warmups, 100 iterations, six paired F/H processes

decision.thesis_impact: closes uniform-angle interpolation and direct power/top1 for materialized FP32 cuFFT
decision.boundary: does not establish a lower bound for pruned NUFFT, CZT, or non-materialized Fourier mechanisms
decision.allowed_wording: A same-grid 4096-point FP32 cuFFT comparator with uniform-angle interpolation and direct power/top-1 takes 27.301 ms, versus 0.470 ms for Beam24.
